translation: Y ⟨los que conocen⟩ tu nombre confiarán en ti, porque tú, YHWH, ⟨has⟩ no abandonado ⟨a⟩ los que ⟨te⟩ buscan, YHWH.

tokens.rationale: Verb from root 982 (batach) meaning to trust or be confident; future tense in context.
Active participle of 3045 (yada) meaning 'knowing ones'; requires explicit article in English.
Construct form of 8034 (shem, name) + 2nd fem. suffix.
Negative particle 3808; 'has' added for English perfect tense.
Piel participle of 1875 (darash) 'seekers' with 2ms suffix; 'a' and 'te' added for natural Spanish.
Divine name 3068; canonical form preserved per Tanaj discipline.
